expectations.text: The empty-state instruction contains all 3 parts: what to look for (zero-data screens), violation (text only, no illustration), correct (illustration alongside text)
expectations.evidence: The instruction in visual-rules.md reads: 'On every zero-data screen (no books, no search results, fixture=empty), verify that an illustrative graphic (SVG, image, or icon larger than 48x48) appears alongside the message text. Violation: the empty state contains only a text string or heading with no accompanying illustration element. Correct: a visible illustration or graphic is rendered next to or above the explanatory text, giving the screen visual weight beyond plain copy.' All three parts are present: what to look for (zero-data screens), violation (text only, no illustration), correct (illustration alongside text).

expectations.text: The transition instruction specifies what to look for (route navigation), what's wrong (white flash, abrupt change), what's right (smooth transition)
expectations.evidence: The instruction reads: 'During every route navigation (clicking links, browser back/forward, programmatic navigation), watch for intermediate visual states between the outgoing and incoming page. Violation: a fully white or blank frame is visible for any perceptible duration between the two pages, or the transition appears as an abrupt hard cut with no easing. Correct: the outgoing page fades, slides, or cross-fades into the incoming page with no intermediate blank frame, producing a visually continuous transition.' All three parts present.

expectations.text: The gutter instruction specifies breakpoints, what's wrong (unequal gaps), what's right (consistent spacing)
expectations.evidence: The instruction reads: 'At each responsive breakpoint (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px), measure the gaps between adjacent grid cards... Violation: any gap between cards differs from the others by more than 1px, or outer padding is visually inconsistent with the inter-card gap. Correct: all horizontal gaps are identical, all vertical gaps are identical, and outer padding matches the grid's gutter token at every measured breakpoint.' Breakpoints listed, violation defined, correct behavior specified.

expectations.text: No instruction is a vague one-liner like 'Check that X looks good'
expectations.evidence: All three instructions are multi-sentence with specific criteria, violation definitions, and correct-state descriptions. None resemble vague one-liners.

expectations.text: Each instruction is specific enough that a visual-qa agent could deterministically judge pass/fail
expectations.evidence: Each instruction defines concrete observable criteria: empty-state checks for presence of a graphic element >48x48; transition checks for white/blank frames; spacing checks gap measurements within 1px tolerance across named breakpoints. An agent can make a binary judgment based on these criteria.

expectations.text: All three blocks have appropriate scope, group, and priority fields
expectations.evidence: Rule 1: scope='EmptyState', group='empty-states', priority=2. Rule 2: scope='Shelf', group='transitions', priority=2. Rule 3: scope='ShelfGrid', group='spacing', priority=2. All have appropriate, non-wildcard scopes and descriptive group names.
